text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects, not just its average cost; avoiding the discomfort of admitting a mistake can keep me in a poor investment.","Selling Stock B and Stock D after gains felt satisfying, but I should not take profits solely to lock in a win—consider whether the stock still merits holding.","My account can fluctuate even when I make no trades, so I should review my positions periodically and make deliberate decisions rather than react to short-term changes."]}
